name: Sabra Kovane

poster.hook: Shrine-warden seeks steady hands for one holy, regrettable night.

story.appearance: Compact, broad dwarf with a soot-grey braid pinned in a flame-knot and heavy forearms scarred by candle wax. Wears Pyrosi priest's chain under a bath-attendant's apron she refuses to remove.
story.concept: Sabra is the warden of the Ash Shrine, a small Pyrosi altar that Pyrosi pilgrims were allowed to build inside the Ouran bathhouse as part of the Concord. She has tended it for thirty years, and in that time the shrine's lamp has taken to answering her, in a voice she recognises from letters. She has been a cleric of the Flame long enough to know that mercy and obedience are not always the same thing.
story.stake: Whatever the vote is, she is the person who will have to carry it out. The Pyrosi rite for ending a burning is hers to perform.
story.goal: Keep her promise to Torvak, and get Vessia to forgive her before the end of the night.
story.secret: Three Jubilees ago the lamp told her that Torvak was tired. He asked her to let him go when the time came and she swore on the flame. She has never told Vessia. She does not know whether keeping her word means betraying her friends.
story.voice: Dry, warm, unhurried; talks to everyone like a patient aunt and to the shrine lamp like an old colleague. Swears in Dwarvish.
mannerisms: Touches the shrine-flame pin on her collar before saying anything difficult
Pours tea for people in emergencies
Talks to fires, then pretends she did not
story.trinket: A tin pilgrim's token worn smooth by thirty years of thumbs

ties.text: Torvak's granddaughter. Sabra reads her his words every Jubilee and has been editing out the last line for three years.
ties.public: Tends the shrine of Vessia's grandfather

ties.text: The stoker and the priest share the furnace-room, a kettle and a running argument about whose schedule comes first. Sabra would trust her with the shrine key, and has.
ties.public: Share the furnace-room, a kettle and an argument

ties.text: The tide-reader arrived this afternoon off the Driftwood barge and asked where he could pray to something that wasn't on fire. She gave him her own seat and a cup of tea.
ties.public: Gave him a seat and tea when he arrived today

story.intro: "Sabra Kovane, warden of the Ash Shrine. Sit. Drink. We have until midnight and I would rather you were warm."

features.name: Darkvision (120 ft)
features.text: See in dim light and darkness out to 120 ft.

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.text: Resist poison damage; advantage on saves against being Poisoned.

features.name: Dwarven Toughness
features.text: Your HP maximum rises by 1 per level.

features.name: Stonecunning
features.text: Bonus Action: tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes while standing on stone.

features.name: Magic Initiate
features.text: Light and Thaumaturgy cantrips; cast Bless once per Long Rest without a slot. Spell ability is Wisdom.

features.name: Divine Order: Protector
features.text: Trained for battle: Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.text: Two uses; regain one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. Options: Divine Spark, Turn Undead, Radiance of the Dawn.

features.name: Divine Spark
features.text: Magic action: 30 ft, roll 1d8 + 4 and either heal that much or deal that much Necrotic or Radiant damage (Con save for half).

features.name: Turn Undead
features.text: Magic action: undead of your choice within 30 ft make a Wis save or are Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.text: Channel Divinity, Magic action: dispel magical darkness within 30 ft; creatures of your choice there make a Con save or take 2d10 + 4 Radiant damage (half on a success).

features.name: Warding Flare
features.text: Reaction: when a creature you can see within 30 ft attacks you, impose Disadvantage on that attack roll.

attacks.name: Scorching Ray
attacks.note: 3 rays with a 2nd-level slot; one more per slot level above 2nd

spellcasting.note: Prepares 7 cleric spells after a Long Rest; domain spells are always prepared. Spell save DC 14, spell attack +6.

attack.name: Word of Radiance
attack.note: Each creature of your choice within 5 ft

choices.label: Pilgrim's token
choices.value: A tin pilgrim's token worn smooth by thirty years of thumbs

choices.label: Dented kettle
choices.value: A palm-sized brass kettle, dented on one side, that she claims is blessed

choices.label: Shrine wick
choices.value: A wick from the first shrine-lamp, wrapped in oilcloth

flashback: What was the first thing the shrine lamp ever said to you, and whose handwriting did you recognise in it?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Sabra is absent: the Ash Shrine's lamp burns unattended and speaks to whoever sits by it in Act 2, in Torvak's voice. Naeris Oulane holds the shrine key. A young Pyrosi acolyte, Ennik, can stand ready to perform the burning-rite if the vote is Release.

reassign.beat: Torvak asked to be let go, and she swore on the flame (letter: the-line-you-cut)
reassign.text: Torvak has told you himself that he is tired, and asked you to let him go when the time comes. You swore on the flame. You have not told his granddaughter, and you do not know if keeping your word betrays your friends.

reassign.beat: The Pyrosi rite for ending a burning
reassign.text: You know the Pyrosi burning-rite, every word of it, and if the vote is Release you will be the one to light the pyre. Nobody else here can, and you have never wanted to.

cuts: The Sabra and Vessia forgiveness subplot and the cut last line.
